tvShows.name: Dr. Aarambhi
tvShows.description: Once an AIPMT topper, Aarambhi’s life is now weighed down by marital duties, but deep within her lies a long-lost dream. Will she get a second chance? Watch Dr. Aarambhi - Hindi Drama Family serial on JioHotstar now.

episodes.duration: During Raj and Naira's haldi celebrations, Dhruv secretly cracks Sunil's locker code to find the hidden papers. Just as he succeeds, Sunil walks into the room.
episodes.episodeName: Dhruv Closes in on the Truth

episodes.duration: Aarambhi worries after noticing bruises on Manmeet then she thanks Dhruv for cheering up Vihaan. Soon, Vishwas assures Avantika that he will divorce Aarambhi before Raj's wedding.
Sunil decides to send Avantika out of the Tandon house at Aarambhi's urging. Aarambhi then confronts Vishwas for opposing her decision, intensifying family tensions.
Aarambhi overcomes her doubts as Raj promises to move on with Naira. Dhruv shocks Sunil by refusing to invest in his hospital, and Sunil throws Avantika out of the house.
As Vishwas and Avantika's dance distracts everyone, Dhruv sneaks into Sunil's room to find crucial papers. His mission takes a shocking turn when Sunil and Dimple catch him.
Aarambhi turns Avantika's scheme against her by switching the tablets. Soon, Vishwas and Avantika's bizarre dance is caught on camera, leaving the Tandon family humiliated.
Sunil and Dimple subtly probe Naira's parents about a dowry. Meanwhile, Vishwas carries out Avantika's plan, which she reveals will drive Aarambhi out of the house.
Raj and Naira's Mehendi ceremony takes an unexpected turn when Avantika secretly spikes Aarambhi and Dhruv's kheer. Soon, Aarambhi feels dizzy as Avantika's plan begins to work.
As Avantika slips into the pool, Vishwas rescues her, prompting Aarambhi to confront him. Raj refuses to marry Naira, but Vishwas urges him to protect the family's reputation.
Aarambhi hunts for CCTV footage to uncover the truth and questions Avantika about Vihaan. Then, Sunil warns the family against making false accusations against Dhruv.
Dhruv defends Aarambhi, but she insists on handling the matter herself. After Mona shows a video of Aarambhi and Dhruv together, Aarambhi reveals she was framed and blames Mona.
Angered by the guests' talk about Aarambhi and Dhruv, Dimple asks Vishwas to expel Aarambhi. As Vishwas raises his hand at her, Dhruv steps in, triggering a heated clash.
Aarambhi grows frantic after spotting Vihaan near the pool. When Vihaan slips into the water, Aarambhi and Dhruv break out of the locked room and rush to rescue him.
As everyone enjoys Raj and Naira's cocktail party, Avantika traps Aarambhi and Dhruv in a room. Unaware of the danger, Vihaan goes to the poolside alone, leaving Aarambhi worried.
Sunil and Dimple panic as an anonymous person threatens to expose their secret. Meanwhile, Avantika and Mona hatch a dangerous plot against Aarambhi involving Vihaan.
The Tandons arrive at the resort for Raj and Naira's wedding. But a fire at the venue and an anonymous message with a photograph leave Dimple and Sunil terrified.
episodes.episodeName: A Threat to Dimple, Sunil's Secret

episodes.duration: Raj confesses his love for Manmeet and refuses to marry Naira. Meanwhile, Avantika demands Raj's wedding be called off as she plots against Aarambhi.
Dhruv warns the Tandon family to hide their troubles and safeguard their investors. Avantika vows to expose Aarambhi to Vishwas and have her cast out with divorce papers.
Avantika dreams of a future with Vishwas, anticipating Aarambhi's divorce. Dhruv consoles Aarambhi as she fears losing Vivaan's custody after the separation.
episodes.episodeName: Avantika Dreams of Life with Vishwas

episodes.duration: Aarambhi is left stunned when Avantika reveals that Vishwas was also involved in Vihaan's kidnapping. Confident that Aarambhi has no proof, Avantika dares her to expose the truth.
Aarambhi boldly confronts Avantika and vows to expose her in front of everyone. Unfazed by Avantika's taunts, Aarambhi reveals that she already knew about her affair with Vishwas.
Dimple is disturbed as Sunil tells her that investors are pulling out of the hospital. Aarambhi finds Vihaan's kidnapping video on Avantika's phone and confronts her with a slap.
Aarambhi is determined to uncover the truth about Avantika's role in Vivaan's kidnapping. As Manju scolds her, Balbir steps in to defend Aarambhi's courageous actions.
Balbir thanks Dhruv for making Aarambhi happy again. Aarambhi tells everyone she went with Dhruv to catch Vivaan's kidnapper and fumes at Avantika for questioning her character.
Spotting Avantika with Vihaan's kidnapper, Aarambhi grows suspicious and sets off in pursuit. Meanwhile, Avantika uses Aarambhi's absence to get close to Naira's family.
Raj and Naira's engagement celebrations kick off with an exciting dance face-off. Amid the festive atmosphere, Aarambhi grows suspicious of Avantika's strange behaviour.
A message on Dimple's blouse about her hiding a truth sparks suspicion in the family. Avantika stirs doubt, hinting that Aarambhi may have pranked Dimple.
As Vishwas and Avantika remain at odds, Raj and Naira's engagement ceremony begins. A brief ring mishap involving Manmeet is resolved, and the couple gets engaged.
Aarambhi is shocked to see Dhruv in her bathroom, while Dimple discovers Naira's engagement ring in Aarambhi's hand. However, Aarambhi uncovers Avantika's plan and warns her.
Avantika spikes Aarambhi's water with sleeping pills and places Naira's jewellery in her hands. As Aarambhi wakes up, Avantika cleverly redirects Dhruv towards her room.
Dhruv sets out to teach Dimple a lesson for not valuing Aarambhi. Avantika plants doubts in Nandita's mind about Aarambhi and Dhruv's intentions.
Dhruv saves Aarambhi from a fall, leaving Avantika anxious that her scheme is unravelling. Vishwas lashes out at Avantika for the chaos that led to Soundharya's injury.
As the Tandon family warmly welcomes Dhruv, Avantika secretly sets her plan in motion. Meanwhile, Sunny threatens Manmeet to stay silent or risk Aarambhi and Raj's lives.
Avantika shares her plan with Vishwas, plotting to frame Aarambhi for an affair with Dhruv. Elsewhere, Naira asks Aarambhi's help to win Raj's heart.
Raj gives his first wedding invitation to Manmeet. During the Roka, Dimple drapes the Shagun Dupatta over Naira, sealing the ritual with deep emotion.
Dhruv learns about Naira's wedding with Raj and later arrives at their Roka ceremony. Everyone is shocked when the Shagun Dupatta accidentally falls over Dhruv and Aarambhi.
As Vishwas blames Aarambhi for Raj's condition and praises Avantika, she tightens her hold on the family. Soon, Raj apologises to Dimple and agrees to Roka with Naira.
Sunny's revelation about Manmeet shocks Raj. Dhruv vows revenge on Vishwas for endangering Kunika and kidnapping Vihaan.
Dhruv calls the police and Vihaan reveals that the kidnappers were taking orders from a woman. Listening to Vishwas and Avantika's conversation, Dhruv uncovers the real mastermind.
Aarambhi is shocked after her termination from the hospital, but Dhruv stands by her side. Later, Vishwas and Aarambhi get into a heated argument.
Sunil welcomes Dhruv and apologises for Vishwas's misunderstanding. Avantika expels Aarambhi from practicing medicine at the hospital.
Vishwas and the family blame Aarambhi, but Kunika strongly defends her. As Vishwas tries to forcibly expel Aarambhi from the hospital, Dhruv stops him.
Sunil scolds Avantika after Kunika goes missing from the hospital. The family confronts Aarambhi for hiding Vihaan's kidnapping and blames her for being irresponsible.
Aarambhi finds Vihaan at a construction site but gets stuck hanging from a high-rise while rescuing him from a kidnapper. Will a saviour arrive to save her?
Aarambhi worries about Vihaan's whereabouts before Kunika's surgery. She finds his school badge and gains courage, believing he is nearby.
Aarambhi seeks Radhika's help to trace Vihaan's kidnapper, while Vihaan escapes from captivity. Avantika makes Aarambhi switch off her phone so she cannot reach Vihaan.
After receiving a warning message, Aarambhi conceals Vihaan's kidnapping from the family out of fear for his safety. Vishwas warns Avantika to take care of Vihaan.
Manmeet panics as a man enters her room and forcefully takes her away. As per Avantika's plan, Aarambhi is assigned to surgery while worrying about the kidnapped Vihaan.
Raj expresses his feelings and decorates the room to impress Manmeet. Avantika's goons kidnap Vihaan while Balbir and Manju are taking him home.
Aarambhi grows suspicious as Avantika assigns her to lead Kunika's surgery. Then, Avantika shares her plan with Vishwas to frame Aarambhi in the surgery.
Aarambhi fearlessly stands against Vishwas and Avantika as tensions continue to rise. Determined to break Aarambhi emotionally, Avantika convinces Vishwas to get Vihaan kidnapped.
Dimple publicly insults Manmeet, accusing her of influencing Raj. She forces her eviction from the flat. Aarambhi steps in to defend her and shifts the focus to Avantika's stay.
Raj confesses his love to Manmeet and seeks shelter. He then tells Aarambhi about his decision and declares he will now live his life independently.
Aarambhi stands by Raj against Dimple's decision, while Raj opens up to Aarambhi about his love for Manmeet. Aarambhi shocks Dimple by revealing that Raj left the house.
Aarambhi bravely stands up against Vishwas and Avantika after saving Vihaan. Amid playful moments and growing tensions, Dimple stuns everyone by arranging Raj's roka with Naira.
episodes.episodeName: A Shocker for Raj and Aarambhi

episodes.duration: Manmeet teaches a lesson to Aarambhi's hospital colleagues who insult her. After Vihaan is found, Vishwas and Aarambhi argue over each other's irresponsible parenting of him.
Dimple arranges Raj's roka ceremony without his consent. Vishwas takes Vihaan out for lunch, after which Vihaan goes missing, causing Vishwas to panic and search for him.
As Aarambhi feels unsure about beginning her medical practice, Soundarya empowers her. Then, Avantika purposely assigns Aarambhi a punishment in an attempt to insult her.
Aarambhi decides to stand strong against Vishwas and Avantika's moves, refusing to lose hope for Vihaan. She then teaches Vihaan self-reliance while facing family criticism.
Sunil grants Aarambhi permission to resume her medical practice at the hospital. However, Vishwas delivers a surprising twist as she must train under Avantika's direct supervision.
Aarambhi impresses all with her confident podcast appearance, sharing her wish to revive her medical career. Soon, Dimple confronts her for taking Avantika's place.
Avantika struggles in the locked storeroom while Vishwas gets furious watching Aarambhi's podcast. Aarambhi smartly handles Dimple's trap questions meant to put her down.
Executing her plan, Aarambhi locks Avantika in a storeroom. As Dimple and Nandita kick off their podcast, they're stunned to see Aarambhi arrive as the guest instead of Avantika.
Manju urges Aarambhi to compromise on her dreams and obey Vishwas. Vishwas tells Dimple that no one in Mumbai will hire Aarambhi for her medical practice.
Aarambhi boldly faces Sunil and Dimple's accusations as tensions rise at home. Manmeet tells her that the medical council doesn't allow her to practice in Mumbai.
Sunil lashes out at Dimple for not watching over Aarambhi and ruining the Tandon family's prestige. Dimple urges Vishwas to control Aarambhi and keep her within limits.
Saniya's reports prove Aarambhi's innocence, and she confronts Avantika for blaming her for Saniya's allergy. The doctor assures Aarambhi that her medical license is safe.
Avantika calls the police, while Vishwas sees a chance to oust Aarambhi from their lives. The police arrest Aarambhi on charges of negligence. How will she prove her innocence?
Vishwas and Dimple are shocked to learn Aarambhi has renewed her medical license. As tensions escalate in the hospital, Avantika accuses Aarambhi of harming Saniya.
Aarambhi is shattered after learning Saniya's secret and recalling Vishwas always siding with Avantika. Vishwas lashes out at the doctor, while Aarambhi stands up for herself.
As a bus accident leaves Saniya battling for life, families rush to the hospital, and tensions rise. Aarambhi is shaken when she learns Saniya is Vishwas' daughter.
Dr. Yadav gives Aarambhi a chance to prove herself by handling an emergency case. Vishwas comforts Avantika when she panics after learning about Saniya's accident.
Trapped by Vishwas, Aarambhi races against time as she cleverly turns Vihaan into her only hope of escape. With danger closing in, her desperate move changes everything.
Vikrant abandons his wedding to find Mannat as shocking truths come out. Aarambhi's bold confession sparks conflict with her family, leading to a heated clash with Vishwas.
As Mannat faints, Malla and Vishakha lock her in a trunk as per Arzoo's plan, leaving Dhairya and Aarambhi worried. Soon, Yashika and Vikrant begin their wedding rituals.
episodes.episodeName: Mahasangam: Mannat Trapped in Arzoo's Plot

episodes.duration: Vikrant's emotions spiral as Dua's arrival sparks joy, leaving Mannat hurt and furious. As truths unravel, Aarambhi's secrets fuel intense drama.
episodes.episodeName: Mahasangam: Vikrant's Heart Gets Divided Again

episodes.duration: Raj promises Manmeet to keep her kidney donation a secret from Aarambhi. Arzoo unknowingly walks into Mannat and Aarambhi's trap after Malla is found to be an incompatible donor.
As Vikrant and Yashika clash over cancelling the wedding, past love between Vikrant and Mannat resurfaces. Meanwhile, Aarambhi alters Arzoo's medical reports, leaving her in shock.
Mannat and Aarambhi's plan succeeds when Arzoo suddenly collapses, causing panic. Accusations rise as tensions explode among everyone.
Aarambhi feels thankful to Mannat for sending Vishwas out of the interview cabin. When Dimple blames Aarambhi for party issues, Mannat tries to expose Avantika.
Aarambhi decides to attend her doctor's license renewal interview despite the risks. Mannat encourages her and diverts Yashika's attention when she tries to spy on them.
Mannat and Aarambhi attempt to alter Arzoo's lab reports to reveal her true identity as Aishwarya. They plan to make Arzoo's health condition seem serious without harming her.
episodes.episodeName: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi's Master Plan

episodes.duration: Dhairya, Aarambhi, and Mannat plot to get Arzoo admitted to the hospital, while Aarambhi smartly pushes Avantika to handle the party responsibilities to impress the Saluja family.
The Tandons arrive at Vikrant and Yashika's Sangeet. Mannat and Aarambhi dance together joyfully, and later Mannat makes Vishwas realise Aarambhi's importance.
Vishwas throws Aarambhi out, but she fights back legally. As Mannat spirals in fear, she turns to Aarambhi for help to expose Arzoo's dark secrets.
Mannat and Aarambhi share their struggles and pain, draw strength from each other, and resolve to fight together for their children's safety and a secure future.
episodes.episodeName: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Uplift Each Other

episodes.duration: Mannat fails to expose Arzoo's truth and plots to deceive Vishakha, while an angry Vishwas throws Aarambhi out of his life. Soon, Aarambhi spots a car rushing toward Mannat!
Aarambhi stands strong for Manmeet and works to prove her innocence. Manmeet makes shocking revelations about Raj's betrayal in front of everyone.
Avantika tells the Tandons that Dr. Manmeet has agreed to leave the hospital. Vishwas confronts Aarambhi, insisting that Manmeet is guilty.
Manmeet confronts Aarambhi for not supporting her after Avantika provokes her. Aarambhi then vows to the Tandon family that she will prove Manmeet's innocence.
The Tandons accuse Manmeet of intoxication and blackmailing intern doctors. Aarambhi senses trouble for Manmeet after realising their plan to keep her away from the hospital.
Aarambhi informs Vishwas about Manmeet, and he promises to handle it. The Tandon family grows anxious about their hospital legacy after hearing the news.
Saniya calls Vishwas as Avantika faints, prompting Vishwas and Dimple to visit her. Aarambhi is shocked when Dimple announces that Avantika and Saniya will stay with them.
Aarambhi stands by Manmeet after Karthik misbehaves with her. As Raj claims innocence and Nandita falsely blames Manmeet, Aarambhi urges Raj to support her in seeking justice.
Avantika vows to win Vishwas's love over Aarambhi. Raj's friends attempt to misbehave with Manmeet, but guided by her prayers, Aarambhi reaches the farmhouse. Can she save Manmeet?
Dimple blames Aarambhi for carelessly bringing artificial Holi colours. Meanwhile, Aarambhi follows a car after spotting three men abducting an unconscious Manmeet.
Manmeet and Raj celebrate Holi with joy and dance at the party. Later, Aarambhi foils Vishwas's plan by swapping the Sindoor with synthetic colour, triggering an allergic reaction.
Aarambhi teases Raj after he accidentally spills colour on Manmeet at the Holi party. Later, she breaks down when she sees Avantika asking Vishwas to apply Sindoor to her.
Raj defies Dimple and stands by Aarambhi despite the threat to evict her. Later, Aarambhi manages the house and her duties as a harsh truth about domestic abuse shakes the family.
Aarambhi hears the painful truth about what the Tandons really think of her. Later, she chooses her dignity and walks out of the house after Vishwas's betrayal.
Aarambhi cleverly tricks Kunika into agreeing to take the injection. Later, Dimple slaps Aarambhi for letting Vihaan play Holi with Anantha and warns her to stay away.
Manmeet confronts Raj, accusing him of complaining about her to Dimple. Later, Aarambhi feels delighted when Kuldeep informs her that she can work as a nurse to treat Kunika.
episodes.episodeName: Aarambhi Takes Up the Nurse's Role

episodes.duration: Manmeet and Raj cross paths as she arrives searching for a room to stay. Meanwhile, Vishwas and Avantika argue about enrolling Saniya and Vihaan in the same school.
Talking with Soundarya, Aarambhi finds the strength to fight and rebuild her life for Vihaan. Later, she begins to suspect Saniya is Avantika and Vishwas's daughter.
Vishwas snatches his draft divorce paper from Vihaan before Aarambhi sees it and fumes at her about parenting. Later, Soundarya comes to work as a cook at Vishwas's house.
Vishwas plans to take over Vihaan's custody, while the invigilator refuses Aarambhi's bloodstained exam paper. Later, Dimple taunts Aarambhi for lacking class and standards.
As Aarambhi cannot hold the kalash with her injured hand, Avantika performs the Kalash Puja. Later, Aarambhi reaches the exam centre but struggles to write due to her injury.
Aarambhi notices Vishwas prioritising Avantika during the Puja, making her feel betrayed and saddened. Later, Vishwas deliberately and secretly injures Avantika's hand.
Aarambhi worries as the house Puja and her medical license reapplication exam timings clash. Later, Vihaan questions Vishwas for not adding Aarambhi's name to the house nameplate.
As Vishwas visits, Aarambhi fears he has learned about her visit to the Medical Council office. Later, she decides to act normally with Vishwas until she secures Vihaan's custody.
Aarambhi struggles to pay her fees and finds the diamond necklace Vishwas gifted is fake. Later, he grows suspicious, learning of Aarambhi's visit to the Medical Council office.
Tensions rise when Koushiki demands Arun sign the divorce papers, sparking a heated family argument. Later, Aarambhi urges Arun to understand Koushiki and resolve their issues.
Manju apologises to Aarambhi for arranging her match with Vishwas. Later, Vishwas asks Avantika for time to sort things out and end his marriage arrangement with Aarambhi.
Manmeet stops Aarambhi from travelling, calling her medically unfit. Later, Aarambhi bribes a staff member to uncover the secret identity of her donor.
Aarambhi decides to become a doctor while staying with Vishwas and the Tandons. Later, the Tandons celebrate their hospital's top ranking in India and plan to expand their legacy.
Vishwas announces his decision to relocate to Mumbai, pretending it is for Aarambhi's health. Determined to restart her life, Aarambhi decides to renew her medical licence.
Manju thanks Vishwas, thinking he arranged a donor for Aarambhi. Later, Aarambhi confides in Radhika about Vishwas's betrayal and vows to rebuild her life for Vihaan's custody.
Aarambhi is taken into the operating theatre for her kidney transplant. After the surgery, she regains consciousness and breaks down, devastated by Vishwas's betrayal.
Radhika angrily confronts Vishwas for refusing to donate his kidney to Aarambhi. Later, Vishwas and Avantika are shocked to learn that Aarambhi has found a kidney donor.
Manmeet warns Manju about the fragile state of Vishwas and Aarambhi's relationship. Later, she undergoes medical tests to see if she can donate a kidney to Aarambhi.
Vishwas admits to Avantika that Aarambhi's death would solve his custody battle once and for all. Later, he outlines his ruthless plan to marry Avantika by removing his wife.
Radhika urges Aarambhi to meet Vishwas to save herself. Later, Aarambhi is shattered when she overhears Vishwas rejoicing over his fate to be with Avantika.
Manmeet warns Aarambhi that she might die without a transplant. Later, Aarambhi consoles Vihaan, assuring him nothing will happen to her.
Aarambhi faints mid-flight and is rushed to the hospital by Manmeet. Later, Vishwas treats her as Avantika witnesses their closeness and feels a sting of jealousy.
Vishwas prioritises Avantika and meets her instead of Aarambhi's mother Manju, breaking his promise. Later, Radhika and Vihaan drop Aarambhi at the airport and wish her luck.
Avantika feels remorse recalling Aarambhi and Vishwas together. Later, Vihaan sweetly wishes Aarambhi and Vishwas on their 10th wedding anniversary.
Vishwas plans a grand proposal for Avantika, but Aarambhi mistakenly believes it's for her and accepts it. Later, Vishwas assures Avantika that he will divorce Aarambhi.
Meet Aarambhi, a housewife and one-time AIPMT topper, rushing to her son Vihaan's project day. As Vishwas wins a medical award, crediting her, will destiny revive her career?
